messages:
zoe: Opened a tiny docs PR to update streaming + pagination snippets (py/ts/go). Main goals: show cancel, show retry shorthand, and demonstrate saving a cursor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5102

matt: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) call out that some older examples used the term 'bookmark' internally, we should update that to `cursor`; 2) include an explicit note that cursors are opaque tokens.

anya: I'll update the code blocks. Keeping each example under 10 lines so they render nicely in the MD.

zoe: Drafts below — super compact. Feedback welcome.

zoe: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# resume with saved cursor (opaque token)
for chunk in c.stream('gpt-medium', prompt='summarize', max_tokens=60, cursor=None, retry={'strategy':'exp','max_attempts':3}):
  print(chunk.text)
```

zoe: ```ts
const ac = new AbortController(); setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),1200)
for await (const p of client.stream('gpt-medium',{prompt:'summarize',maxTokens:60,cursor:null,signal:ac.signal,retry:{strategy:'exp',maxAttempts:3}})) console.log(p.text)
```

zoe: ```go
ctx,cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),1500*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
iter := client.Stream(ctx, "gpt-medium", redwood.StreamOpts{Prompt:"summarize", MaxTokens:60, Cursor:""})
for iter.Next() { fmt.Println(iter.Current().Text) }
```

ci-bot: lint: please use `max_tokens` in Python examples; go imports OK. Also flagged an inline HTTP link earlier, removed.

matt: Looks good. Add a one-liner under each snippet: "Cursor is opaque; store and pass back unchanged to resume." Also add a GH Action `examples-smoke` that runs the three snippets behind an env guard.

anya: I'll add the smoke job and swap Python param name to `max_tokens`. Will push updates shortly.

sam: :thumbsup: If CI smoke passes I'll merge.
